{{Cancer}}
Cancer 17 is the 213th day of the year in the [[Gaian calendar]]. It is the 17th day of Cancer, and it is a Wednesday. It corresponds to ISO week 31, weekday 3.

Its informal Japanese name is 8宮17日.

On this day, [[Gaiad chapter 213|Chapter 213]] of the [[Gaiad]] is read.

To see structured data on this date see {{q|Q152233}}.
